propositions: The snapshot-entry schema contract in _snapshot_schema.py is not enforced because fetcher.py never imports it and no production module uses it.
The schema encodes a parent present-vs-absent distinction that gates an inbound CLEAR operation whose history contains a revert for data destruction.
The snapshot contract is hand-rolled outside the existing src/rebar/schemas/ machinery where 90 sibling schemas are enforced via generated TypedDict and CI drift gate.
Real fetcher output fixtures exist in bridge_state/snapshots/ with PII but are gitignored; a redacted fixture covering populated, parent-absent, and empty shapes must be created.
Moving the snapshot contract into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrating it with schemas.load() and the existing generated-types drift gate will ensure contract divergence fails CI.
